notes.text: Their sales team calls nonstop all day, basically guilt-tripping me into buying upgrades I never asked for.
Aunty asked my salary before my name. Ma'am, at least say hello first.
Half the people on here are just window shopping and treat marriage apps like casual Tinder hookups.
Biodata said 'fair, slim, homely'. Are we meeting a person or buying a sofa?
People accept my request and then never reply, which honestly makes me think they are fake bots.
First question: 'What does your father do?' I am right here. Ask about me.
Talking to parent-managed accounts feels like a job interview where they only care about my CTC and property.
Rejected because I 'laugh too loudly'. I'm keeping the laugh.
So many fake profiles with stolen photos are just trying to pitch shady crypto scams in the chat.
'Adjusting nature' is on every biodata. So who is doing all this adjusting?
Even after I filter out specific criteria, the app keeps shoving the exact same rejected profiles back.
I just want my parents and me looking at the same shortlist. That's it. That's the rant.
